rowText.steps: Get a chip with a label longer than its 130px slot, measure the label's scroll speed against PRESET_MARQUEE_SPEED.
rowText.expected: Matches the intended per-second rate; this is a numeric check, not a "does it feel right" judgement.

reads.chipLabel: how does the excursion funnel work in portal 2
reads.note: The label scrolls two duplicate copies of the text side by side (a standard marquee loop); one copy's width divided by the CSS --duration variable gives the real on-screen speed.

verdictSentence: The chip's label actually scrolls at about 27 pixels per second on screen, close to the calibrated 25 the code asks for -- a slow, readable crawl, not a fast or jerky one.
